name: codeagent-mobile
description: Start, supervise and review your AI coding agents from a conversation.

interface.longDescription:
CodeAgent Mobile lets you start, monitor, redirect and review long-running AI coding agents without leaving the conversation.

Connect your CodeAgent account and ask for your sessions, send a task or a new instruction to an agent, answer the questions it asks, stop it, read the changes it made and open a pull request. Hand a session to your phone when you step away and keep supervising from the CodeAgent Mobile app.

Works with the coding agents you already link in your CodeAgent account. Switching a session to another agent always asks for your confirmation first.

Requires a CodeAgent Mobile account with at least one paired session (local CLI, GitHub Codespace, CodeAgent Box or self-hosted server).
defaultPrompt: Show me my running CodeAgent sessions
What has the agent changed so far?
Send this session to my phone
